response.sql: WITH o AS (SELECT ordersmark, AVG(remaincount) AS a FROM orderexecutions GROUP BY ordersmark), ov AS (SELECT AVG(remaincount) AS m FROM orderexecutions), g1 AS (SELECT o.ordersmark, o.a FROM o, ov WHERE o.a > ov.m), g AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS m2 FROM g1), f AS (SELECT g1.a FROM g1, g WHERE g1.a > g.m2) SELECT AVG(f.a) AS avg_of_avgs, AVG(f.a - ov.m) AS avg_excess_overall, AVG(f.a - g.m2) AS avg_excess_group FROM f, ov, g
